name: Visbek (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Visbek (a blue wavy bend with a fish on yellow).
history: A flag and a banner were approved by the President of the Verwaltungsbezirk Oldenburg on 23 July 1969.

features.role: Visbek arms — wavy bend with fish on yellow
